_about: The Figma section 'Seller Portal' exported as ONE image lays its 41 screens out in a grid. This lists their node ids in reading order (rows top to bottom, left to right), checked against the pictures on 2026-10-16. catalog_exports.py needs it to name the slices; if the designer adds, removes or moves screens in that section, the count stops matching and the tool refuses to guess: re-check the order and update this file.
